Hi all,
 
See below cost comps PTK vs. JC Vietnam.
Vietnam is the 20-39 unit MOQ (highest cost).

Jacob, Paul.

 

Perhaps it would be good to arrange a call to discuss. I know our prices are significantly higher than the target prices you provided us.

 

Firstly, I believe there is some room for Value engineering, but this will only be able to get a few percent out, not the 20 or 30% needed to meet your target prices.

 

Secondly, I would say that it is important that you recognise this isn’t an apples to apples comparison to your existing suppliers. Our materials and quality are not on the same level as your current suppliers. I’m assuming the reason you contacted us for this project was to improve quality and reliability for your indoor collections. It isn’t reasonable to expect a good supplier with good quality to be the same price as a poor supplier with lots of issues… you generally get what you pay for.

 

Finally… I am prepared to help start the ball rolling by accepting the lowest price (over 80 MOQ) as the base price for the first 12 months. Meaning if you order 20 you will still get the over 80 price. Hopefully this will be enough time for you to realise the benefits of going for quality over price.

 

One observation regarding your target price. The product we supply RH is only marked up by RH by 3.8 to 4.2 times from our sell price. Most of your items were over 6 times mark up, 6.8 in many cases. This mark-up structure seems very high to me.

 

Please let me know if you’d like to have a call to discuss. I can make myself available anytime.

 

Best regards,Jonathan SowterChief Executive Officer
